random.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen showing a cross-section of an intervertebral disc with surrounding bone. The section displays degenerative changes within the disc material, characterized by structural fissuring and discoloration of the nucleus pulposus. These findings are consistent with severe intervertebral disc degeneration or disc herniation.
